title: Product Designer Especialista
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Nosso Cliente

A oportunidade é para atuar em uma empresa líder global em soluções transacionais, que há mais de 50 anos conecta empresas, colaboradores e comerciantes ao redor do mundo.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Product Designer com forte foco em criar experiências que conectem negócios e consumidores em soluções híbridas B2B e B2C . Você será responsável por desenvolver produtos digitais centrados no usuário, equilibrando usabilidade, viabilidade técnica e valor de negócio, com atuação estratégica em pesquisa e validação de hipóteses .

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Conduzir o processo de descoberta (discovery) em parceria com Product Managers, engenheiros e stakeholders, mapeando jornadas, dores e oportunidades.
  • Planejar, executar e analisar pesquisas qualitativas e quantitativas com clientes corporativos e usuários finais.
  • Transformar insights de pesquisa em soluções tangíveis — wireframes, fluxos, protótipos e testes de usabilidade .
  • Atuar em soluções híbridas (B2B e B2C) , considerando diferentes perfis de usuários, contextos e níveis de decisão.
  • Colaborar com o time de produto na definição de hipóteses, priorização e experimentação de soluções (design-driven discovery).
  • Garantir consistência visual e de experiência por meio de design systems e boas práticas de UI/UX.
  • Contribuir para o fortalecimento de uma cultura de design orientada por dados e pesquisa contínua.

O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência comprovada como Product Designer, UX Designer ou Service Designer , com atuação em produtos digitais.
  • Domínio de Figma e outras ferramentas de prototipagem e colaboração.
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em User Research (entrevistas, testes de usabilidade, surveys e análise comportamental).
  • Capacidade de traduzir descobertas em decisões de produto claras e práticas .
  • Mentalidade data-informed , com foco em métricas de impacto (NPS, adoção, engajamento e retenção).
  • Excelente comunicação e habilidade para influenciar decisões estratégicas de produto.

Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Experiência em plataformas complexas (marketplaces, SaaS, mobilidade, fintechs).
  • Familiaridade com Design Ops e gestão de Design Systems .
  • Conhecimento em experimentação e testes A/B .
  • Atuação prévia em pesquisa aplicada ou customer experience .

Onde você vai trabalhar?

Celebramos a troca, relações e o poder do contato. Regime Híbrido

title: Senior Facilities Manager
description:
Primary Purpose of the Position

The Senior Facilities Manager is responsible for the strategic and operational management of the school’s facilities, ensuring a safe, functional, and efficient environment for the school community. This professional coordinates the maintenance, electrical, civil, and operational support teams, as well as the outsourced contracts for gardening and cleaning services, ensuring service quality, meeting deadlines, and controlling costs. They plan and execute preventive and corrective maintenance programs, manage the department’s budget, and ensure the legal compliance of the buildings.

Main Duties and Responsibilities

  • Directly manage the maintenance, electrical, civil, and operational support teams.
  • Manage outsourced contracts for gardening, cleaning, and other related services.
  • Plan and execute the annual preventive and corrective maintenance schedule.
  • Oversee, together with the Technical Construction Consultant, large-scale projects and interventions, ensuring alignment with quality standards, deadlines, and budget.
  • Develop and control the department’s budget, including operational costs and infrastructure investments.
  • Monitor the performance of vendors and contractors, ensuring the quality and efficiency of the services provided.
  • Develop and track facilities performance indicators (KPIs), such as costs, response time, and operational availability.
  • Keep all legal and technical building documentation up to date (e.g., fire department inspection certificate, accessibility reports, and other mandatory certifications).
  • Support inspections and audits.
  • Coordinate campus support activities such as events, sports, and material movement.
  • Ensure a safe and appropriate physical environment for both academic and administrative activities.
  • Promote the efficient use of campus spaces and resources, in alignment with other school departments.
  • Lead the Facilities team, fostering people management, performance evaluation, and professional development opportunities.
  • Support the Director of Business and Operations in strategic decisions related to infrastructure and investments.
  • Maintain effective communication with various departments, including academic areas, to ensure operational alignment and support for school activities

Certifications and Education

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering

Experience

Mínimo de 10 anos de experiência em gestão de facilities, manutenção predial ou áreas correlatas

Previous experience in the education sector or in complex service institutions- Desired

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

Proficiency in English.

Strong leadership skills and ability to manage multidisciplinary teams.

Experience in budgeting, planning, and cost control.

Knowledge of safety, environmental, and building maintenance standards.

title: Computer Vision Engineer (AI & Retail Analytics)
description:
About Aravita

At Aravita, we are on a mission to solve one of the world's biggest challenges: fresh food waste. Our AI-powered platform uses intelligent forecasting and order recommendations to optimize fresh food operations, reduce overstocking, and minimize out-of-stock items. We are a passionate, innovative team looking for a new member to help us build this fresh-focused technology and be part of a positive change.

The Role

We are looking for a highly-motivated Computer Vision Engineer to join our AI team. This is a hands-on role where you will be responsible for building, training, and deploying the computer vision models at the heart of our next-generation retail analytics platform.

Your primary mission will be to analyze images from grocery store shelves to perform:

  • SKU & Planogram Recognition: understand what products are where on the shelf.
  • Quantity Estimation & Stockout Detection: accurately count or estimate product quantities and automatically detect empty spaces.

This role is perfect for a  problem-solver and a  quick learner who is obsessed with shipping code and seeing their models create real-world impact. The outputs you build will be a critical input for our core forecasting and logistics models.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Build & Train: design and train deep learning models for object detection, image classification, and segmentation in a complex, real-world retail environment.
  • Critically Think & Evaluate: you won't just build—you'll analyze. You will benchmark and integrate custom models (e.g., YOLO) against third-party AI services (like Google Vertex AI and Azure AI Vision) to find the best-fit solution for the problem.
  • Master the Data: work with large, imbalanced, and often challenging image datasets and develop clever strategies for data augmentation and annotation.
  • Collaborate & Deploy: work closely with our data science and engineering teams to deploy your models into a scalable production environment.

Our Ideal Candidate...

  • Is a  problem-solver first . You are excited by a complex challenge and have the critical thinking skills to break it down.
  • Is a  fast learner . You might not know every tool on day one, but you have the fundamentals and drive to learn them quickly.
  • Is  hands-on and results-oriented . You have a bias for action and a passion for building and shipping solutions.
  • Has strong  Python skills and hands-on experience with a major ML framework like  PyTorch or  TensorFlow .
  • Has a solid understanding of computer vision principles and deep learning models (e.g., CNNs, object detection, transfer learning).

What You'll Work With (And Learn)

This is a fantastic opportunity to get hands-on experience with a state-of-the-art stack.  You don't need to be an expert in all of these today, but you should be excited to learn them.

  • Custom Models: YOLO, ResNet, and other SOTA architectures.
  • Core Toolkit: Python, OpenCV, PyTorch/TensorFlow.
  • Cloud AI Services: Google Vertex AI Vision & Azure AI Vision.
  • Emerging Tech: exploring multimodal LLMs for image analysis.
  • MLOps: production model deployment, monitoring, and versioning.

Bonus Points (Nice to Have)

  • A personal or academic portfolio of computer vision projects.
  • Experience with managed AI services from Google Cloud or Azure.
  • Familiarity with MLOps tools and best practices.
  • Location: candidates based in or near  São Paulo, SP , are preferred for occasional team meetups.

Principais atividades:

•Aprovar horas de acordo com o realizado do mês.

Buscamos alguém que apresente:

•Experiência como Líder Técnico ou Coordenador de Tecnologia, gerenciando equipes de desenvolvimento de software

•Experiência com governança de repositórios, ferramentas de cloud e implementação de políticas de Segurança da Informação, Engenharia de dados.

•Experiência com cloud computing(AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).

•Familiaridade com práticas de observabilidade(monitoramento, logging e alertas).

Nossa essência inspira o dia a dia, por isso, buscamos pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem, e que:

• Identifiquem e antecipem as necessidades dos clientes, agindo prontamente para encontrar soluções adequadas e personalizadas;

• Planejem e executem o trabalho com excelência a fim de atingir os resultados esperados, com a visão de inovação e agilidade;

• Gerem e implementem novas ideias, buscando constantemente por melhorias para a experimentação de novas abordagens e a adaptação às mudanças do mercado.

title: ANALISTA RELAÇÕES COM INVESTIDORES SR.
description:

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Job Title: DevOps Engineer

Duration: 12 months (ASAP Start)

Work Type: Hybrid (3 Days Onsite per Week)

Location: São Paulo, Brazil )

Position Overview:

We are seeking an experienced DevOps Engineer to design, implement, and maintain scalable, secure, and efficient DevOps solutions in Azure. The ideal candidate will have deep hands-on experience with Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) , CI/CD pipelines , and infrastructure automation , with a strong background in cloud architecture and system reliability.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align DevOps practices with business goals.
  • Support incident , problem , and change management processes.
  • Architect, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for retail applications.
  • Deploy and manage containerized workloads using Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) and Kubernetes.
  • Manage and optimize Azure infrastructure , ensuring performance, scalability, and cost-efficiency.
  • Automate infrastructure provisioning using Terraform , ARM templates , and scripting tools ( PowerShell , Bash , Python ).
  • Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting with Azure Monitor , Grafana , and related tools.
  • Support day-to-day DevOps operations and contribute to environment stability.
  • Develop and maintain scripts for automation and system optimization.
  • Ensure digital security, perform vulnerability management, and participate in disaster recovery planning and testing .
  • Troubleshoot networking, infrastructure, and deployment issues.

Essential Skills & Experience

  • 8+ years of experience in technology with a strong focus on DevOps and cloud engineering .
  • Deep expertise in Microsoft Azure , including virtual machines, AKS, networking, storage, load balancers, and security.
  • Strong understanding of containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Hands-on experience building and managing CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitLab).
  • Proficient in infrastructure as code (IaC) using Terraform, ARM templates, or similar tools.
  • Solid programming experience in one or more languages: C#, Java, or Python .
  • Strong SQL and database experience (MS SQL Server, SSIS, SSRS, SSAS).
  • Skilled in scripting ( PowerShell , Bash ) and automation frameworks.
  • Experience applying modern Service Delivery methods — Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and ITIL-based processes.
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with proven ability to work across teams.
  • Knowledge of cloud security best practices , including IAM, firewalls, and network security groups.

Desired Qualifications

  • Microsoft Certified: Azure DevOps Engineer Expert — validating expertise in designing and implementing DevOps practices on Azure.
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert — demonstrating advanced Azure solution design skills.
  • Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) — validating Kubernetes deployment and management proficiency
  • Experience with retail or wholesale trading systems is a plus.

title: Reporter
description:
Risk Event-Driven Distressed (REDD) Intelligence is looking for a reporter to cover corporates in Brazil out of our office in Sao Paulo.

The reporter will have a notable track record covering and breaking news and a solid understanding of the corporate credit space, working closely with our experienced team of financial reporters and analysts to cover performing/distressed corporates in Brazil.

Day-to-day activities include:

  • Breaking news on corporate finance and operations, turnarounds and restructurings, legal, regulatory and market developments affecting Brazilian issuers
  • Working closely with our market-leading team of reporters and analysts across the global emerging markets
  • Analysis of finance, economics, legal situations and other data affecting corporates under coverage

Requirements:

  • A minimum three to five years’ experience with coverage of Brazil’s corporate space
  • A deep network of contacts in the business, asset management, banking, and legal communities
  • Knowledge of the corporate bond market and global/onshore credit
  • Facility with financial data and analysis related to coverage of the corporate space
  • Knowledge of the local dynamics affecting corporates under coverage
  • The ability to work collaboratively in a deadline-driven, fast-paced environment
  • Excellent English language writing skills

About REDD:

REDD produces real-time news and analysis on emerging market corporate and sovereign event-driven special situations, helping asset managers, bankers, and advisers assess opportunities in the high-yield and high-grade markets.

REDD is a strong proponent of gender and racial diversity, and an equal opportunity employer. We are a motivated team of free thinkers and expect our team members to be personable and dynamic, encouraging “out of the box” thinking and the ability to discuss and appreciate different points of view to avoid the blind spots presented by group think.

We can offer you an opportunity to pursue a challenging but rewarding career with ample progression within a diverse international organisation. We also offer a market-leading competitive salary package and flexible working arrangements.

Headquartered in London with bureaus across the global emerging markets, REDD Intelligence’s team is made up of professionals with investment banking, legal and financial reporting experience, leveraging regional relationships to report on catalysts related to a universe of over 3,500 companies and sovereigns under coverage.

title: Merchant Onboarding Analyst (Shift Position)
description:
About us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to revolutionize food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage! Within just one year, Keeta has become an industry leader in Hong Kong. With our ongoing expansions into Saudi Arabia, Keeta achieved the remarkable feat of launching 5 cities in just 17 days, allowing the Arabic world to witness the speed of China! Keeta offers exciting opportunities to join a transformative journey that is shaping the future of delivery and retail. Join Keeta, explore the world.

Know more: Keeta website.

What you'll Do :

1. Review documents and information provided by merchants to ensure accuracy before the store goes live.

2. Upload and verify merchant account details, ensuring all information is complete, correct, and efficiently processed.

3. Check merchant qualifications according to company rules.

4. Review other applications submitted by business colleagues or merchants.

5. Organize and manage store photo-taking services.

6. Work according to a shift schedule (5x2), including night shifts and weekends.

7. Collaborate with Operations, Product, and other relevant teams to support merchant onboarding and resolve related issues.

What we need from You :

1. Responsible and reliable, willing to work hard to achieve team goals.

2. Eager to learn, open to new things, and able to adapt to changes.

3. Good communication skills, a team player, and willing to grow together with others.

4. Portuguese speaker, fluent in both spoken and written Portuguese. sales support is a plus (training will be provided).

5. Willing and able to work according to a shift schedule (5x2), including shift weekends.

6. Able to work efficiently under pressure, especially during peak periods, and handle handovers and transitions between teams smoothly.

7. Strong sense of responsibility and attention to detail in managing shift tasks and onboarding processes.

What makes this role excinting :

1. Take part in the rapid growth of Meituan's global delivery business, work with an international team, and enjoy plenty of opportunities to learn and grow.

2. Friendly and supportive team environment, where helps each other and grows together. Fun and relaxed atmosphere with everyone clear career development paths.

Why Join Keeta

Keeta is redefining the future of food delivery with a clear vision and innovative spirit. As a fast-scaling brand under Meituan's global ambition, we offer a unique blend of stability and startup energy, providing boundless opportunities for personal and professional growth. Whether you want to specialize in your field or gain cross-functional experience, Keeta empowers you to take charge of your career.

As we expand globally, we are committed to building a workplace that reflects our unique culture while incorporating global best practices. You'll be part of a company that's transforming the delivery industry while supporting local communities, empowering merchants, and delivering outstanding customer experiences.

At Keeta, you'll collaborate with a passionate and pragmatic global team across over 94 countries, bringing diverse perspectives that drive creativity and innovation. We believe diversity is our strength and it pushes us to deliver better solutions for our customers and partners in Hong Kong, Saudi Arabia, and beyond.

Keeta offers limitless career growth and equal development opportunities, empowering you to grow as the company grows. Every day presents an opportunity for you to make a meaningful impact, grow professionally, and be part of something extraordinary. You'll thrive in a dynamic environment where every contribution is valued. Together, let's build the future of food delivery.

title: Workday Recruiting and Talent Analyst
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo?

Então essa é a sua chance!

Buscamos: Workday Recruiting and Talent Analyst

About the Role

As a key member of our Workday Application Management Support team, the Workday Recruiting and Talent Analyst will own the configuration, maintenance, and support of our Recruiting, Talent, Performance and Learning modules.

You will partner closely with HR and Talent Acquisition Teams to ensure Workday solutions align with evolving business needs, legal / regulatory requirements, and employee experience goals.

This role requires deep functional expertise in Workday configuration, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to translate HR and Recruiting requirements into scalable Workday solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Maximize the effectiveness of Workday by configuring, maintaining, and continuously optimizing Workday Recruiting, Talent, Performance, and Learning modules.
  • Enable better talent decisions and development by supporting scalable, user-friendly solutions for career growth, goal tracking, and feedback collection.
  • Enhance the candidate and employee experience by resolving issues and queries that impact usability, accuracy, or workflow across recruiting and talent modules.
  • Drive the success of the annual performance review cycle by owning the configuration, launch, monitoring, and post-cycle review of performance processes, while identifying opportunities for process and system improvements.
  • Ensure data accuracy and process scalability by preparing, loading, and validating EIBs for mass data updates.
  • Maximize system performance and adoption by evaluating new Workday releases, identifying relevant enhancements, and recommending high-impact improvements to stakeholders.
  • Ensure system reliability and business continuity by proactively monitoring health and resolving issues across Recruiting and Talent modules.
  • Improve transparency and knowledge sharing by maintaining clear, user-friendly documentation for configurations, business processes, and system policies.
  • Accelerate continuous improvement initiatives through cross-functional collaboration with analysts, IT teams, HR, Talent Acquisition and business stakeholders, delivering enhancements that add value and reduce manual effort.
  • Safeguard data integrity and compliance by ensuring configurations align with internal governance, audit requirements, and security standards.
  • Enhance user confidence and self-service adoption by contributing to the development of end-user training materials in partnership with HR.

title: Sales Director South America (Automotive)
description:
Company Overview:

AEW Automotive is a leading international supplier of advanced engineering solutions, components, and systems for the automotive industry. With a strong commitment to innovation, quality, and customer satisfaction, AEW partners with global OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers to drive technological excellence and sustainability across the mobility sector.

As we expand our footprint in South America, we are looking for a highly motivated and entrepreneurial Sales Director to lead our business development and sales efforts in the region.

Position Overview:

The Sales Director South America will be responsible for developing and executing AEW Automotive’s go-to-market and growth strategy across Brazil and the broader South American region.

The focus will initially be on new business acquisition and strategic relationship building with automotive OEMs, Tier 1, and Tier 2 suppliers. This role requires a dynamic hunter personality with strong industry knowledge, entrepreneurial drive, and the ability to establish AEW as a trusted partner in the region.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute a regional sales and business development strategy aligned with AEW’s global objectives.
  • Identify, pursue, and close new business opportunities with OEMs, Tier 1, and Tier 2 automotive customers in South America.
  • Establish and nurture long-term customer relationships to drive sustainable growth.
  • Conduct market analysis to identify key trends, emerging technologies, and potential business partners.
  • Collaborate closely with AEW’s global engineering, product, and operations teams to tailor solutions to customer needs.
  • Manage the entire sales cycle from lead generation to contract negotiation and closure.
  • Represent AEW at industry events, trade fairs, and conferences across the region.
  • Provide regular reporting on sales performance, pipeline development, and market insights to the global leadership team.

Qualifications and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business Administration, or related field (Master’s degree preferred).
  • Minimum 6+ years of experience in sales or business development within the automotive industry , ideally with international exposure.
  • Proven track record of generating new business and achieving sales targets.
  • Strong understanding of automotive supply chains and OEM/Tier 1 ecosystems in South America.
  • Excellent negotiation, presentation, and relationship management skills.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English ; Spanish is a plus.
  • Willingness to travel across South America as needed.

Personal Profile:

  • Entrepreneurial, hunter-minded sales professional with high energy and resilience.
  • Strong strategic thinker with hands-on execution capabilities.
  • Results-driven, self-motivated, and capable of working independently in a remote setup.
  • Excellent intercultural communication and collaboration skills.

  • Build automation solutions leveraging Workato , MuleSoft , and custom code (Node.js, JavaScript).
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders (Sales, Marketing, Support, Finance) to understand business processes and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Develop APIs and workflows that enhance data flow and system interoperability.
  • Troubleshoot integration issues and ensure consistent system performance and scalability.

Required Technical Skills

Preferred Experience

  • Exposure to DevOps , Git branching , and Agile methodologies .
  • Experience with Salesforce frameworks like CPQ, Experience Cloud, or Einstein.
  • Solid understanding of data flows, declarative automation vs. custom development, and integration best practices.

Ideal Profile

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with attention to detail.

Temu tax team ensures compliance with local and international tax laws while optimizing the company’s tax position. title: Latin America Finance Business Partner - Sales & Marketing and Field Operations
description:
Latin America Finance Business Partner - Sales & Marketing and Field Operations

Role Overview:

We are seeking a proactive, dynamic and hands-on Finance Business Partner to support our Sales & Marketing and Field Operations teams across the Latin America region. This is a high-impact role where you will play a critical part in driving business performance, offering strategic financial insights, and providing actionable recommendations to enable growth and operational efficiency. You will be the key finance partner for these teams, working closely with Latam senior leadership to track field and sales performance, and ensure that business goals are met within budget.

On a typical day you will:

  • Strategic Financial Partnering: Serve as a trusted partner to Sales & Marketing and Field Operations teams, working on the databases and providing financial insights that drive decision-making and support business strategies.
  • Budgeting & Forecasting: Lead the budgeting and forecasting process for Sales & Marketing and Field Operations organizations. Develop and maintain rolling forecasts, track budget variances, and ensure financial targets are aligned with operational goals.
  • Business Performance Analysis: Analyze financial data and key performance metrics for both Sales & Marketing and Field Operations. Provide insights into revenue generation, profitability, and cost control, helping to optimize spending and improve financial outcomes.
  • Cost Management & Efficiency: Collaborate with operational leaders to identify areas for cost reduction, process improvements, and operational efficiencies within the sales and field operations domains.
  • Financial Reporting: Prepare regular financial reports and presentations for senior management, highlighting key trends, risks, and opportunities in the business. Present clear, actionable recommendations based on financial analysis.
  • KPIs and Metrics: Develop and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to monitor the success of sales and marketing campaigns and field operations. Ensure alignment with business objectives and provide actionable recommendations for improvement.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with world headquarters in Finance, Sales & Marketing, and Field Operations, fostering collaboration and ensuring alignment between financial and operational goals.
  • Ad Hoc Financial Support: Provide ad-hoc financial analysis and support as needed for special projects, strategic initiatives, and decision-making processes.

What You Will Need to be Successful:

  • Educational Background: Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Accounting, Economics or Engineering (MBA or professional finance qualification preferred).
  • Fluent English and Spanish. Strong interaction with Latin America countries and headquarters in the United States, through conference calls and in person meetings.
  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in managerial roles as finance business partnering, and/or financial planning & analysis, ideally with experience in Sales & Marketing and/or Operations environments.
  • Analytical Skills: Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex financial data, draw insights, and make strategic recommendations.
  • Business Acumen: Understanding of sales, marketing, and field operations metrics and the ability to translate these into actionable financial strategies.
  • Communication Skills: Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to present complex financial data in a clear and compelling way to non-financial stakeholders.
  • Advanced Excel skills (including financial modeling) and Hyperion Financial Management (HFM) Oracle Hyperion Financial Management.
  • Collaboration: Proven ability to work cross-functionally with various business units and senior leadership to influence decision-making.
  • Problem Solving: Strong critical thinking and problem-solving abilities, with a proactive approach to identifying financial trends and issues.

Desirable

title: Integration Solution-Team Leader
description:

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to transform food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage.

In less than one year, Keeta became an industry leader in Hong Kong, China. Soon after, we expanded into Saudi Arabia and are now present in more than 20 cities. Following our recent successful launch in Qatar, Kuwait and the UAE, we're bringing that same speed and innovation to more of the Middle East, and to Brazil.

Job Responsibilities

  1. Team Management & Goal Achievement: Oversee daily operations and team management of the integration solution group, allocate resources reasonably, and lead the team to achieve goals in system integration, product optimization, and customer support.
  2. Integration Project Coordination & Delivery: Lead the planning, implementation, and delivery of integration projects involving external API service providers, hardware devices (such as printers), and internal systems, ensuring compliant and efficient execution.
  3. Technical Solution Design & Optimization: Analyze customer and business needs, coordinate with technical teams to implement system connectivity, process optimization, and new feature development, continuously improving the quality and stability of overall integration solutions.
  4. Quality & Process Control: Establish and optimize team collaboration, product testing, launch processes, and integration standards; monitor key indicators to ensure high-standard deliverables.
  5. Complex Problem Solving & Technical Challenges: Lead the team to analyze and resolve complex technical issues in project integration and device operation, promote targeted technical solutions, and ensure successful client implementation.
  6. Cross-Departmental Communication & Collaboration: Act as the core liaison within the team, work closely with sales, technical, product, and operation teams to coordinate project progress and improve business synergy.
  7. Team Development & Capability Building: Develop and organize systematic training and growth plans for team members, continuously identify and cultivate talents, and build a high-performing and cohesive team.
  8. Industry Trend Insights & Innovation: Stay updated on order-taking solution development in the restaurant/merchant industry, including APIs, hardware, and apps; drive innovation in integration solutions and lead the professional advancement of the team.

Job Requirements

  1. Bachelor’s degree or above, preferably in Computer Science, Information Management, E-commerce, or related fields.
  2. At least 3 years of experience in technical integration, system implementation, product operations, or related team management, with a preference for experience in large-scale API, hardware, or integrated solution project management.
  3. Strong technical solution analysis, design, and optimization abilities; able to systematically solve complex technical and business problems.
  4. Familiar with API interfaces, hardware products (such as printers), apps, and various integration methods; deep understanding of overall solutions for the merchant industry is a plus.
  5. Outstanding cross-team communication, coordination, and project management skills; able to drive collaboration and achieve project goals.
  6. Ability to organize team training and development, nurture talent, and build a high-performing team.
  7. Results-oriented, highly resilient, and self-driven, with awareness of process optimization and high-standard quality control.
  8. Native-level Portuguese and strong proficiency in English (listening, speaking, reading, and writing); able to communicate efficiently in an international and diverse environment. 9.Experience in restaurant/merchant integration projects or industry solution operations is a plus.

Job Highlights

  1. Early-Stage Business: Opportunity to participate in early-stage planning, design, and implementation of team and projects, driving core technology and product innovation.
  2. International Team: Work with colleagues from 26 countries, experience a diverse and open work environment, and expand your global perspective.

A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. 7. Relacionamento e Atendimento ao Cliente

  • Coletar feedbacks e traduzir as necessidades do cliente em melhorias na solução.
  • Capacidade de comunicar insights técnicos e estratégicos de forma clara. Experiência na apresentação de relatórios e sugestões de melhoria.

title: Sr. Technical Customer Success Analyst
description:
Title: Sr. Customer Support Analyst

Business Unit: Graphic Communications

Location: Brazil, Remote

Graphic Communications( a CAI Division) is a leading global provider of industry-specific business and production software technology for print industries. Graphic Communications ’s integrated and automated software offerings and point solutions are designed to enable revenue growth and drive operating and production efficiencies. With several offices worldwide, and over thirty-years dedicated to delivering best-in-class technology to the printing industries, it is our deeply held philosophy that Graphic Communications succeeds when our customers thrive. For more information, visit us at

As a Sr. Customer Support Analyst , you will troubleshoot complex customer requests, manage the global support queue and backlog, and ensure exceptional, timely service for our valued customers. Reporting directly to the Sr. Manager, Customer Success , you will play a crucial role in driving customer satisfaction, retention, and long-term success.

In this role, you will combine your technical expertise, analytical thinking, and customer-focused mindset to deliver high-quality solutions to critical support issues. You will act as a trusted technical advisor to customers, collaborating closely with internal teams to diagnose, resolve, and prevent recurring issues.

Your key responsibilities include delivering specialized technical solutions to escalated support cases, providing a proactive, personalized customer experience, and strengthening the partnership between the Customer Support Team and Graphic Communication’s clients through technical excellence and accountability.

Key Responsibilities

  • Answer incoming telephone calls and open cases in Salesforce, identifying customers, populating case details, and confirming data accuracy.
  • Monitor the Global Support queue and accept Salesforce cases in priority sequence.
  • Review case priority and maintain strict adherence to SLA requirements based on severity and impact.
  • Troubleshoot customer-reported issues, identify root causes, and provide timely solutions via case updates, calls, or screen-sharing sessions.
  • Provide customer support via email, Teams, and telephone using discretion, experience, and technical judgment.
  • Escalate or re-route cases to appropriate Tier 2 or Tier 3 teams after thorough investigation while maintaining SLA compliance.
  • Allocate resources, systems, and solutions to ensure efficient issue resolution.
  • Identify customers’ operational and business challenges, guiding them and the Graphic Communications team toward effective resolutions.
  • Document and submit solutions to the knowledge base with complete technical and procedural details.
  • Close cases with accurate and comprehensive resolution documentation.
  • Collaborate closely with R&D and Services teams to replicate and resolve complex technical issues.
  • Test, analyze, organize, and report progress on ongoing customer cases.
  • Ensure accountability and progress tracking through Salesforce reporting and analytics.
  • Manage and prioritize active support cases within your queue while maintaining strong communication with customers.
  • Make informed case routing decisions, escalating appropriately based on technical complexity.
  • Follow up with clients on outstanding queries and provide proactive updates.
  • Notify clients about new software releases, coordinating with Marketing to ensure customers are informed of relevant fixes and improvements.
  • Collaborate with Tiered Support peers and Development teams for environment setup, database capture, and other technical tasks as required.

Technical Troubleshooting Responsibilities

  • Use Chrome Developer Tools (Inspector) to analyze web applications, review network requests, debug front-end issues, and identify JavaScript or API failures.
  • Perform API testing and validation using tools such as Postman or cURL.
  • Conduct IIS and SSL diagnostics to investigate and resolve issues on Windows Application Servers.
  • Configure and troubleshoot Windows ADFS Servers and perform remote diagnostics via VPN, RDP, or similar tools.
  • Assist customers with database backups, migrations, and SQL troubleshooting using SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS), write scripts, stored procedures, and queries.
  • Utilize network tracing tools (e.g., Wireshark, Fiddler) to diagnose connectivity, latency, or certificate-related issues.
  • Perform log analysis across web, application, and system logs to identify root causes of performance or access issues.
  • Understanding of web deployment and troubleshooting for ASP.NET-based applications and related components.
  • Maintain proficiency in analyzing browser console errors, network calls, and response payloads to pinpoint issues in customer environments.
  • Participate in proactive system health checks, monitoring server performance metrics and application uptime indicators.

Experience Requirements

  • Minimum 8+ years of customer support experience.
  • ERP/MIS background preferred.
  • Print industry knowledge is mandatory.
  • Experience with tools such as Salesforce, JIRA, and Confluence preferred.
  • Strong understanding of support operations and troubleshooting methodologies.
  • Ability to solve problems efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Self-starter with the ability to work with minimal guidance.
  • Confident in delegating tasks and providing peer guidance.
  • Willing to work in shifts as required.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
  • Strong documentation and organizational abilities.
  • Data analysis skills (reports, dashboards, and metrics).
  • Proficient in general computing, internet research, and email communication.
  • Understanding of web development, SSO, Active Directory, and SSL.
  • Hands-on experience with VPN configuration, network management, and SQL scripting.

Education

  • Degree in Technology, Engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent hands-on experience in customer support and enterprise systems.
  • Strong understanding of software troubleshooting, printing workflows, and IT infrastructure preferred.

title: Sr. Business Analyst & Product Design
description:
Role Overview:

The Business Analyst – Product Designer is a key member of the design team, partnering with business stakeholders and solution architects to deliver value-added features for sales, marketing, and billing teams. While the primary focus is on Service Sales CRM solutions, this role also provides exposure to a suite of enterprise applications. The BA transforms stakeholder visions into functional features, documents requirements, and works closely with development teams to bring solutions to life.

On a typical day you will:

  • Assess business processes, system landscapes, and user pain points to recommend technical solutions and workarounds.
  • Facilitate requirements gathering and functional design sessions with business and technical stakeholders.
  • Document detailed functional design specifications (epics, features, user stories).
  • Lead refinement sessions with Scrum teams to review feature designs, estimate effort, and prepare for sprint cycles.
  • Support QA and UAT test planning, execution, and bug triage.
  • Present live product demonstrations and prepare release notes for end users.
  • Assist with sprint planning, stakeholder communications, and retrospectives to drive continuous improvement.
  • Contribute to change management through documentation, training, and stakeholder engagement.

What You Will Need to be Successful:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 2+ years of experience in business analysis, product design, or related roles, ideally within CRM platforms.
  • Strong background in requirements gathering, process mapping, and translating business needs into technical specifications.
  • Hands-on experience with Agile delivery methods, including writing user stories and partnering with Scrum teams.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional and global stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with CRM platforms (Microsoft Dynamics 365 Sales strongly preferred) and exposure to cloud-based solutions, APIs, and system integrations.

Local Benefits or Selling Statement

This role offers the opportunity to work in a global environment, gaining exposure to local and international stakeholders. You will grow both business and technical skillsets while shaping CRM and enterprise applications that drive real impact across unique business streams.

Apply today to join us and build what’s next!.

title: Bolsista Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial - Grupo Boticario - Bioguardian
description:
A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.

O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses , promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado , ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico , favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico . A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências , e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável .

Sobre a Oportunidade:

No Grupo Boticário, a busca por inovação sustentável e ciência aplicada à beleza se traduz em iniciativas que integram tecnologia, pesquisa e propósito. Nesse contexto, o projeto prevê o desenvolvimento e a validação de metodologias baseadas em técnicas avançadas de biologia molecular, com o objetivo de aprimorar a precisão e a confiabilidade das análises microbiológicas relacionadas à qualidade e à segurança de produtos e processos.

O profissional selecionado também poderá atuar em estudos voltados para a compreensão de aspectos biológicos relevantes ao cuidado da pele, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento de soluções mais eficazes e alinhadas às necessidades dos consumidores. Trata-se de uma oportunidade estratégica, inserida em um ambiente que valoriza inovação, rigor científico e excelência em beleza e bem-estar.

Formação Acadêmica:

Doutorado completo Doutorado em Química, Farmácia, Biologia, Biotecnologia, Bioquímica e áreas correlatas

Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos.

Idioma: Inglês intermediário

Projeto: Bioguardian

Principais Atividades:

  • Apoiar nas rotinas de microbiologia: preparo de meios, cultivo e manutenção de microrganismos.
  • Realizar cultivo celular (linhagens 2D e 3D), incluindo preparo de meios, passagens e criopreservação.
  • Participar da implementação e manutenção de modelos 3D e sistemas organ-on-a-chip.
  • Executar técnicas básicas de biologia molecular (extração de DNA/RNA, PCR, ELISA).
  • Apoiar em procedimentos histológicos (fixação, corte, coloração e análise de lâminas).
  • Organizar e registrar dados experimentais, contribuindo na elaboração de relatórios técnicos.
  • Participar da discussão e apresentação de resultados em reuniões de grupo.
  • Auxiliar na redação de artigos científicos e preparação de pôsteres e apresentações.
  • Colaborar na organização e manutenção do laboratório e de materiais de uso comum.

Requisitos Técnicos Mínimos

  • Capacidade de conduzir pesquisas, analisar dados e interpretar resultados para apoiar a tomada de decisões;
  • Boa habilidade de comunicação oral e escrita;
  • Aptidão para atuação colaborativa em equipes multidisciplinares;
  • Proatividade na identificação e resolução de problemas;
  • Flexibilidade para lidar com mudanças nas diretrizes, regulamentações e necessidades do projeto;
  • Mentalidade orientada para resultados, com foco em cumprimento de prazos e avanços consistentes;

Requisitos Técnicos Desejáveis / Diferenciais

  • Técnicas de Biologia Molecular, preferencialmente RT-qPCR e PCR Digital
  • Conhecimentos em análises microbiológicas;
  • Experiência com cultivo celular.

Valor da bolsa (mensal) : Bolsista (Doutor) R$ 5.000 – Programa Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial

description:

We are seeking experienced professionals with deep functional expertise in ServiceNow products , including Customer Service Management (CSM), IT Service Management (ITSM) , or HR Service Delivery (HRSD) , to contribute to AI model training initiatives.

This role focuses on translating real business workflows and decision logic into structured, data-driven tasks that strengthen AI reasoning and understanding of enterprise processes. It is not a platform configuration or app development role .

Role Overview

The ideal candidate will combine ServiceNow domain expertise , analytical capability , and prompt-engineering skills to design realistic, scenario-based tasks for AI learning.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define decision frameworks for Reinforcement Learning initiatives, including taxonomy design, realistic scenario creation, and evaluation criteria.
  • Develop scenario-driven tasks that mirror real ServiceNow workflows (case handling, SLA tracking, HR requests, IT incident response).
  • Write clear, natural instructions aligned with ServiceNow business processes.
  • Represent tasks in JSON format with clarity and consistency.
  • Use SQL to analyze and validate data accuracy.
  • Apply prompt engineering to structure effective task instructions.
  • Collaborate with peers to expand scenarios across ServiceNow domains (CSM, ITSM, HRSD).
  • Document patterns, examples, and best practices for scalable use.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 4–6 years of experience in ServiceNow, particularly CSM, ITSM, or HRSD modules.
  • Strong knowledge of workflows, cases, incidents, SLAs, and knowledge management.
  • Proficiency in JSON and structured data handling .
  • Solid understanding of SQL for data validation.
  • Experience in AI model training workflows or structured data creation.
  • Strong prompt engineering , analytical, and logical structuring skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills (customer-facing experience is a plus).

Preferred Qualifications

  • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA)
  • Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS–ITSM / CSM / HRSD)
  • Exposure to AI/ML workflows and Agile methodologies
  • Knowledge of prompt engineering best practices

title: EDI Open Text (Inglês Avançado)
description:
Job Description:

We are seeking a skilled and experienced Salesforce Lead to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will lead and own the full software development life cycle (SDLC) of Salesforce projects, providing technical leadership and ensuring successful delivery of high-quality solutions. This role requires collaboration with business stakeholders and cross-functional teams to gather requirements and translate them into technical specifications.

Responsibilities:

Lead and own the full software development life cycle (SDLC) of Salesforce projects, including requirement analysis, design, development, testing, deployment, and support.

Collaborate with business stakeholders and cross-functional teams to gather requirements and translate them into technical specifications.

Design and implement customized solutions on the Salesforce platform using Apex, Lightning Components (Aura/LWC), Visualforce, SOAP/Rest APIs, and declarative tools.

Focus on Salesforce Vlocity development with an emphasis on Enterprise Product Catalog (EPC)/CPQ, Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM), OmniScripts, DataRaptors, and Integration Procedures (IPs).

Manage offshore team and support existing Salesforce applications, including troubleshooting, bug fixing, and performance tuning.

Provide technical leadership to junior developers, including planning, assigning, and reviewing their tasks, to ensure timely and high-quality delivery.

Collaborate with business stakeholders to prioritize tickets based on urgency, impact, and business value.

Estimate effort and timelines for user stories and tasks to support effective sprint planning.

Plan and create sprints, ensuring a balanced workload and alignment with project timelines and objectives.

Assign tasks to team members based on skillsets, availability, and delivery priorities.

Conduct daily stand-up meetings to track progress, gather updates, and identify and resolve blockers.

Coordinate cross-functionally to ensure timely resolution of dependencies and issues impacting delivery.

Liaise with the testing team to review test scenarios and support test planning activities.

Coordinate with business users for UAT (User Acceptance Testing), ensuring validation of functionality and obtaining final sign-off.

Conduct detailed code reviews and handle deployments using GitHub and Jenkins.

Hold accountability for the successful delivery of assigned Salesforce solutions, meeting both technical and business expectations.

Stay updated with Salesforce platform enhancements and proactively manage critical release updates.

Qualifications:

Proven experience leading Salesforce projects through the full SDLC.

Expertise in Apex, Lightning Components (Aura/LWC), Visualforce, SOAP/REST APIs, and Salesforce declarative tools.

Strong background in Salesforce Vlocity development, particularly with EPC/CPQ, CLM, OmniScripts, DataRaptors, and IPs.

Experience managing offshore teams and supporting existing Salesforce applications.

Ability to provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior developers.

Proficient in performing code reviews and handling deployments using GitHub and Jenkins.

Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

Proactive approach to stay informed about platform enhancements and release updates.

Experience in coordinating with business stakeholders to prioritize work, plan sprints, and ensure smooth project delivery.

About Us

Cadence () is a language services firm servicing the due diligence industry. We started in Beijing in 2014 and the types of clients we serve are expert networks, investment firms, consulting firms and market research firms. We are a remote-first company whose staff is located across multiple countries. Each individual is functionally aligned to one of three time zones (APAC, EMEA, Americas). We strive to promote internally whenever possible, so this is a limited opportunity to join a company that values ambitious and efficient professionals keen to develop their career.

Key Responsibilities

You are a project manager for our interpretation team. Your job title would be Associate on our Client Service team. The full career track associated with this role can be seen on our careers page .

You'll play a key role in ensuring clients' interpretation and market research needs are met with precision and efficiency. Your responsibilities will centre around three core areas: project management, client communication, and ad-hoc recruitment of specialized language professionals. As you master these core functions, opportunities may arise for managing more complex projects, assuming enhanced client-facing roles, and collaborating with Client Service Managers on strategic planning, furthering your growth within the Client Services team.

Our interpretation team covers both remote projects and on-site projects.

Note - this role is to manage interpretation projects, not to actually interpret on behalf of clients.

The Job

You will manage multiple projects per day.

Projects can begin and end on the same day (”I need an interpreter for a call at 8pm tonight”).

Or they can span several weeks (”I am hosting three focus groups in three Chinese cities and need moderators to facilitate the focus groups and translate the output into English”).

Here’s how you will interact with a project:

Scoping

  • You will speak with clients via email, phone, or WeChat about their needs
  • You will work with colleagues to ensure the client’s expectations for quality, speed, and cost are met
  • You will identify colleagues to assist based on the relevant time zones or regions for the project

Matchmaking

  • Your top responsibility is to identify the best linguist in our community for the client’s objective
  • You will need to present that linguists’ experience in a relevant way for the project
  • ... or you will need to recruit a new one if there isn’t an ideal match
  • You will need to constantly evaluate profitability and client satisfaction

Executing

  • You will need to sync up expectations between client(s) and linguist(s)
  • You may need to chaperone calls to ensure they begin successfully
  • You will need to speak with clients after projects to make sure they are satisfied

Key Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field
  • Fluency in English. Fluency in an additional language is a bonus.
  • Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM systems
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and client service skills
  • Strong organizational and multitasking abilities
  • Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to work effectively in both independent and team environments
  • Goal-oriented, driven, and highly motivated to succeed & take on challenges
  • Entry-level to intermediate-level candidates are welcome to apply: any relevant work experience is a plus

Working Hours & Location

  • This is a fully-remote role where you can work from home ( WFH )
  • You will work either APAC, AMER or EMEA business hours , but wherever possible, it will be your local region (eg - LatAm applicants will work AMER hours)
  • Weekends and overnights shifts are available with a commensurate increase in compensation.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary commensurate with experience
  • Paid time off
  • Health insurance
  • Annual allowance for professional development expenses

title: Supervisor de SGI
description:
Somos o Grupo SADA!

Um grupo referência em transporte e logística, além de atuação em diversos segmentos de negócios movidos por milhares de pessoas dispostas a darem o seu melhor, todos os dias. Somos serviços, informação, indústria, concessionárias, energia limpa, esporte e responsabilidade social movimentando a vida das pessoas há mais de 45 anos, e é isso que nos faz ir mais longe.

Venha para uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar no Brasil. Uma empresa que cuida das pessoas e se preocupa em proporcionar um ambiente de trabalho cada vez mais saudável e seguro, pois queremos que nossos colaboradores sempre sintam orgulho de trabalhar aqui.

Somos plurais por natureza, um grupo diverso em negócios e pessoas. Acreditamos que as diferenças somam e movimentam, e é por isso que o Grupo SADA quer conhecer você. Todas as nossas vagas são extensivas as Pessoas com Deficiência e profissionais reabilitados do INSS. Quem sabe alguma oportunidade combina com você.

Resumo da Posição:

Estamos em busca de um(a) Supervisor(a) de Sistema de Gestão Integrado (SGI) para se juntar à nossa equipe na Deva Veículos . Responsável por supervisionar, implementar e manter o Sistema de Gestão Integrado da empresa, garantindo o cumprimento dos requisitos das normas ISO e das políticas internas relacionadas à qualidade, meio ambiente, saúde e segurança do trabalho. Atua na promoção da melhoria contínua dos processos e no fortalecimento da cultura de conformidade e sustentabilidade organizacional.

Principais Atividades:

  • Supervisionar e garantir a manutenção das certificações ISO (9001, 14001 e 45001);
  • Coordenar auditorias internas e externas, acompanhando planos de ação e prazos;
  • Apoiar as áreas na identificação e controle de riscos operacionais e ambientais;
  • Elaborar, revisar e atualizar procedimentos, políticas e instruções de trabalho;
  • Monitorar indicadores de desempenho e promover ações corretivas e preventivas;
  • Realizar treinamentos e campanhas de conscientização sobre SGI;
  • Apoiar na gestão de resíduos, controle de documentos e requisitos legais aplicáveis;
  • Assegurar que as práticas de saúde, segurança e meio ambiente estejam alinhadas às exigências legais e aos padrões corporativos.

Requisitos:

  • Formação superior completa em Engenharia, Administração, Gestão Ambiental ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência anterior com SGI e auditorias internas/externas;
  • Conhecimento das normas ISO 9001, ISO 14001 e ISO 45001;
  • Pacote Office intermediário/avançado;
  • Habilidade em gestão de pessoas e comunicação interpessoal.

Se você se identifica com a vaga e atende aos requisitos, candidate-se através do botão abaixo. Estamos ansiosos para conhecer você!

NOSSA HISTÓRIA

Para contar a história do nosso grupo empresarial precisamos voltar ao Brasil dos anos 70, quando um jovem visionário desembarcava da Europa trazendo objetivos bem audaciosos. Ali, iniciava a trajetória da SADA, com a implantação de uma pequena transportadora na região metropolitana de Belo Horizonte.

Fundada em 4 de agosto de 1976, na cidade de Contagem, em Minas Gerais, a SADA Transportes e Armazéns S/A foi criada, a partir da necessidade de atender as demandas de armazenagem e distribuição automobilística no país.

Sete anos depois, em 1983, a empresa é transferida para Betim em um terreno de cerca de 31 mil metros quadrados, 23 vezes menor que a área ocupada pela empresa atualmente.

“Ainda muito jovem, cheguei aqui vindo da Itália com a tarefa de montar a SADA no Brasil junto com a chegada da Fiat”, conta Vittorio Medioli, fundador presidente do Grupo SADA.

Assim como seu precursor, a origem do nome SADA também é italiana:

TRADIÇÃO EM CRESCER

Apesar das dificuldades políticas e econômicas da época, a empresa estabeleceu uma tradição em crescer, valorizando o trabalho em equipe e as habilidades individuais dos colaboradores em um ambiente onde todos se sentem orgulhosos de construir uma história de solidez e grandes conquistas.

description:

Na Bren, não construímos chatbots genéricos. Nosso produto é uma plataforma avançada de múltiplos agentes (vendas, suporte, insights) que orquestra conversas de alta performance no WhatsApp. Você será responsável por projetar, construir e otimizar os "cérebros" por trás dessas interações, transformando dados brutos de conversas em vendas reais e experiências hiper-personalizadas.

Sobre a Bren

A Bren é uma startup inovadora que transforma conversas em vendas, se comunicando com os clientes através do WhatsApp, 24 horas por dia. Acreditamos que equipes de vendas são essenciais para o crescimento de uma empresa, e por isso criamos soluções de automação e comunicação que aumentam a produtividade e tornam os processos mais eficientes. Nossa plataforma oferece funcionalidades como agendamento de reuniões, campanhas inteligentes, follow-up automatizado e muito mais, sempre com a voz da marca e com a inteligência da IA.

Responsabilidades

Sua missão será evoluir a inteligência central da nossa plataforma:

  • Desenvolver a Arquitetura Multi-Agente: Projetar, implementar e otimizar os agentes de IA (vendas, suporte, insights) e a "camada de inteligência unificada" que os orquestra.
  • Otimizar a Tomada de Decisão: Desenvolver a lógica que permite aos agentes interagir com sistemas de terceiros (ex: gateways de pagamento, calendários, CRMs) para executar tarefas complexas, como um "Frictionless Shopping Journey" dentro do WhatsApp.
  • Pesquisa e Inovação: Manter-se na vanguarda das técnicas de IA Generativa, testando e implementando novas arquiteturas de agentes, modelos e frameworks para garantir a liderança tecnológica da Bren.
  • Colaboração: Trabalhar em conjunto com o time técnico (backend, frontend, e arquitetura) para integrar as capacidades de IA de forma escalável e segura na nossa infraestrutura (FastAPI + GCP).

Stack de IA e Ferramentas

  • Linguagem Principal: Python
  • Frameworks de IA: LangChain, LlamaIndex, ou similares
  • Modelos: Experiência prática com APIs de LLMs e/ou modelos open-source
  • Bancos de Dados: Experiência com Bancos Vetoriais (Vector Databases) (ex: Pinecone, Chroma, PGVector) e SQL
  • Backend & Infra: FastAPI, Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

Perfil Ideal

  • Experiência Central: Experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento e produção de sistemas de IA Generativa, especialmente com arquiteturas de agentes (Agentic AI) .
  • Conhecimento Técnico: Proficiência em Python e frameworks como LangChain (ou similares).
  • Domínio de RAG: Profundo conhecimento de técnicas de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) , embeddings e o uso de Vector Databases .
  • Visão de Produto: Capacidade de traduzir desafios de negócios complexos (como vendas conversacionais) em soluções de IA robustas e escaláveis.
  • Infraestrutura: Familiaridade com Google Cloud Platform (GCP) (ou AWS/Azure), especialmente serviços relacionados a AI/ML.
  • Engenharia de Software: Experiência com desenvolvimento de APIs (idealmente FastAPI ) e boas práticas de engenharia para colocar modelos em produção.
  • Diferenciais: Experiência prévia com a API da Meta (WhatsApp Cloud API) e Whatsapp Flow é um grande diferencial.

Modalidade

  • Trabalho remoto

title: COORDENADOR DE DESENVOLVIMENTO DE SISTEMA
description:
Quem somos

Criada em 2012, a Farmarcas é um agrupamento que conecta redes de drogarias associativistas em todo o Brasil. Nosso papel é oferecer soluções estratégicas, ferramentas inovadoras e suporte especializado para apoiar o desenvolvimento de empreendedores do setor.

Nosso objetivo é transformar sonhos em realidade, melhorando a vida de centenas de empresários independentes e de seus milhares de colaboradores em mais de 1.700 farmácias espalhadas de norte a sul do país.

Atualmente, reunimos 11 redes de drogarias associativistas e seguimos escrevendo as melhores histórias do associativismo farmacêutico brasileiro.

Estamos à procura de um(a) Coordenador de Desenvolvimento de Sistemas:

Procuramos profissionais que queiram trabalhar em uma empresa repleta de desafios, novidades e muito aprendizado! O seu desafio será por coordenar o desenvolvimento de projetos e produtos Farmarcas, assegurando a conformidade com os padrões de qualidade e o cumprimento dos prazos estabelecidos, garantir a sustentação dos projetos lançados, visando aprimorar a experiência do usuário e o sucesso do produto.

O que você vai fazer:

  • Liderar com propósito: conduzir projetos e produtos de tecnologia alinhando estratégia e inovação, sempre com foco em gerar valor para o negócio e melhorar a experiência dos nossos usuários;
  • Engajar e direcionar times: coordenar equipes internas e terceirizadas com base em indicadores, acompanhamento diário e um olhar próximo sobre entregas e resultados;
  • Garantir excelência técnica: incentivar boas práticas de desenvolvimento, promover code reviews e fortalecer padrões que assegurem qualidade e consistência;
  • Atuar como parceiro(a) estratégico(a): contribuir na definição da arquitetura de novos projetos, equilibrando escalabilidade, desempenho, segurança e custo-benefício;
  • Antecipar desafios e oportunidades: identificar riscos e propor melhorias contínuas nos processos de desenvolvimento, assegurando a estabilidade e disponibilidade dos sistemas;
  • Promover desenvolvimento humano: acompanhar a jornada de cada colaborador através de PDIs, feedbacks e iniciativas de capacitação, fortalecendo uma cultura colaborativa e de aprendizado constante.

Para este desafio é necessário:

  • Experiência em liderança de times de desenvolvimento e gestão de performance;
  • Sólido conhecimento em desenvolvimento de software e boas práticas de código;
  • Vivência com arquitetura de micro serviços (C#, APIs/BFF), micro front-end (Angular);
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais (MySQL, MongoDB, etc.);
  • Familiaridade com processos de CI/CD e ambientes Cloud (AWS);
  • Habilidade em negociação, resolução de conflitos e metodologias ágeis.

Diferenciais para o cargo:

  • Vivência com linguagem PHP 8+;
  • Conhecimento em Ferramentas para Análise de Código (SonarQube);
  • Conhecimento e aplicação de processos de DevSecOps (Práticas que ajudam as organizações a proteger seu software, infraestrutura, aplicativos e dados);
  • Gestão orçamentária (Forecast).

Modelo de Trabalho: Presencial no escritório em São Paulo/SP, próximo à estação de metrô Santa Cruz (linha azul).

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
Hey, Dingus!

Yeah, you heard that right.

Dingus & Zazzy is looking for a versatile, out-of-the-box Sales Development Rep in Brazil. As the first line of communication with a prospect, the ideal SDR is someone who loves cold calling, has CRM experience, carries a hunter mentality, and loves to be coached on advanced selling tactics.

About Us

Dingus & Zazzy is a comprehensive digital marketing agency offering services for brands looking to expand their presence across a variety of digital platforms. Our business is expanding globally, and we need talented folks on our team to continue offering stellar service to our clients.

Running a company is a little like building a plane while flying it. There’s always too much to do; doing one thing means neglecting something else. You have to blog but also be active on social media. You have to build websites and then optimize them for mobile. Email lists. Emails. Keywords. SEM. SEO. UX. UI. FML. OMG. That’s where we come in. We provide an unlimited get-shit-done subscription for our clients. And we need your help!

Responsibilities Include

  • Utilizing HubSpot, cold calls, and email to generate sales opportunities

title: Analista de Planejamento Integrado Pleno(a)
description:
Somos um ecossistema de negócios único e inovador, que conecta usinas associadas, parceiros estratégicos e empresas investidas, fornecendo energia renovável, alimento natural e contribuindo para a transição energética e a segurança alimentar mundial. Nossa trajetória é marcada pelo pioneirismo e colaboração: tivemos um papel fundamental no processo de desenvolvimento do agronegócio e no crescimento sustentável do setor, elevando o Brasil à uma posição de vanguarda na produção e comercialização de bioenergia. Por meio de uma ampla capacidade de atuação, logística inteligente e, principalmente, elos fortes com nossa rede de parceiros, estamos mais preparados do que nunca para ir cada vez mais longe.

Sobre a Área de Atuação:

Nossa área de Planejamento olha muito atentamente para as demandas das usinas, precisamos conhecer o perfil de cada unidade / grupo econômico e estar em contato ativo com elas para desenharmos o escoamento mais eficiente dos produtos, sem nunca perder o foco quanto a necessidade das áreas comerciais e logísticas da Copersucar, por isso um profissional que tenha capacidade de entender o todo e que tenha a capacidade de tomar decisões rápidas é muito importante. Além disso, também desempenhamos um papel de controle de estoques e balanço de produtos, sendo assim capacidade de organização também é uma habilidade estimada para esta vaga.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Acompanhamento e suporte na construção de S&OP
  • Controle Mensal das Reclassificações de Produto;
  • Construção da Régua de Exportação ME - apuração de ToP + Fobagem Break Bulk;
  • Controle de Estoques por BU (Alvean / MI);
  • Plano de Escoamento das Usinas;
  • Aderência do Plano de Escoamento das Usinas;
  • Participação dos fóruns operacionais de movimentação para deliberações de dia a dia;
  • Suporte e atendimento das Usinas Cooperadas;
  • Monitoramento da autonomia de Produção das Usinas.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Administração; Comércio Exterior; Finanças; ou áreas Correlatas
  • Experiência atuando com planejamento de demanda e S&OP
  • Pacote Office (Intermediário)
  • Conhecimento de SAP e Sales Force (Diferencial).

Informações adicionais

  • Assistência Médica Bradesco;
  • Assistência Odontológica Bradesco;
  • Vale Refeição (R$58,00 por/dia) ou Alimentação;
  • Vale Transporte;
  • Auxílio Creche para funcionárias (Crianças até 2 anos de idade)
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Auxílio Medicamento;
  • Remuneração Variável de Curto Prazo - PLR
  • Previdência Privada;
  • Wellhub;
  • Massagem 1x por semana no escritório (de acordo com disponibilidade);
  • Café da manhã no escritório.
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em regime híbrido de 4x presencial em nosso escritório na Av: Nações Unidas 14261, São Paulo SP.

Nutrimos talentos, impulsionamos carreiras

Somos um ecossistema movido pela força coletiva de talentos únicos. Por isso, valorizamos o papel de cada colaborador em nossa jornada de evolução, nutrindo a diversidade de ideias e opiniões e incentivando o desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional de cada um.

Nossos Valores

Construímos o futuro, hoje

Olhamos para o futuro com visão estratégica sempre em busca de oportunidades para o nosso ecossistema e para nossas pessoas.

Avaliamos o contexto e nos adaptamos com agilidade, capacidade de entrega e inovação. Reconhecemos nosso passado e confiamos no nosso modelo de negócio e nas nossas equipes. Por isso nos desafiamos diariamente e tomamos decisões pragmáticas e audaciosas.

Cumprimos o que combinamos

Fazer o que é certo é mais do que a nossa obrigação, é nosso compromisso: Construímos relações de confiança porque só prometemos o que podemos entregar e sempre cumprimos o que combinamos.

Somos reconhecidos porque praticamos o que, de fato, acreditamos. Temos a imensa responsabilidade de colaborar com a transição energética e a segurança alimentar, que são fundamentais para as pessoas e o planeta e isso é que nos inspira e orienta.

Praticamos a colaboração

A cooperação é a nossa essência. Nascemos como cooperativa e a força do nosso negócio está nos vínculos que construímos e sustentamos.

Nosso ecossistema é feito pela soma de diferentes especializações e pela intenção genuína de valorizar a contribuição de cada um. Gostamos de trabalhar juntos, de pedir e oferecer ajuda, de contribuir com o todo.

Somos movidos por resultado

Sabemos que são os resultados que viabilizam o crescimento dos nossos negócios, as soluções em escala, o desenvolvimento das pessoas e o fortalecimento dos agentes do ecossistema.

Por isso, estamos sempre em busca de oportunidades de fazer melhor o nosso trabalho, otimizando processos e buscando eficiência de tempo, recursos e energia em toda a nossa cadeia de valor.
